templatesUnavailable: Notification templates could not be loaded. Refresh to retry.
templateEventHelp: Changing the event loads its recommended template. Changing language preserves existing rules.
activityHelp: Calendar time zone: {zone}. Weeks start on Monday. Duration includes observed online time; counts include confirmed session starts. Success rate uses completed checks.
CachedReconciliationHelp: The worker read the current Telegram status on schedule. This does not mean the person just came online or went offline.
TelegramUpdateHelp: Telegram pushed a new user status and the worker updated the record.
ConnectionUnavailableHelp: The worker cannot reach Telegram. Presence is unknown and this does not trigger an offline notification.
AccountNotReadyHelp: The monitoring account is not signed in or is reconnecting. Check the account page.
ObservationFailedHelp: This check did not return a valid status. Scheduled checks will continue; this does not mean the person went offline.
RateLimitedHelp: Telegram requested fewer calls. The worker will try later; avoid repeated manual retries.
ExpiredOnlineStatusHelp: The previous online status expired. Presence becomes unknown; expiration does not count as going offline.
WorkerInterruptedHelp: The worker restarted before this check completed. It is counted as an unsuccessful check.
NoObservationHelp: No usable status has arrived yet. Check that the target and Telegram account are enabled.
TargetReconfiguredHelp: The monitoring account or identifier changed. Old profile information is discarded until the next check.
AccountReconfiguredHelp: Telegram account settings changed and the worker is rebuilding its session.
WorkerUnavailableHelp: The worker heartbeat expired. Continued monitoring cannot currently be confirmed.
MonitoringDisabledHelp: This target is disabled and scheduled checks are stopped.
Observation resumedHelp: The worker can observe presence again. The interruption stays unknown rather than being counted as offline.
calendarSwipe: Swipe between months or use the pagination below.
